title: MHSafeEval: Role-Aware Interaction-Level Evaluation of Mental Health Safety in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates clinical safety and interaction-level harm in mental health counseling settings using a specialized taxonomy (R-MHSafe). While clinical safety and harm prevention are fundamental to AI ethics, the paper's focus is on behavioral and psychological harm categories (e.g., gaslighting, dependency induction) rather than benchmarking religious topics, abstract moral reasoning, or formal ethical frameworks.
